review: Independent M6 integration review by numerical-core agent; integration files reviewed read-only
methods: In-memory Node evaluation of actual web/m6.js functions with minimal DOM stubs (no browser/source mutation)
Real generated paired-sweep corruption test with native start/objective recomputation

findings.problem: New strict robust-disclosure check rejected starts=[] pending job envelopes before queueing; infrastructure failures with no native problem also could not persist.
findings.original_reproduction: POST /api/m6/runs =>400 Saved robust assumptions or decision disclosures disagree with options;8service tests had1failure+2errors.
findings.repair: Core now validates experiment/options/M4 envelope first, accepts empty pending/running envelopes and explicit infrastructure-failed envelopes with no finite estimates and inspectable messages. Finite outcomes retain all strict numerical recomputation.

findings.problem: Deleting initial_reference_entry allowed an imported paired artifact to contain a different physical initial geometry while retaining pairing claims.
findings.original_reproduction: Second variant initial x[2]+=.2; recompute initial geometry/native parameters/initial+second-stage costs; set reference null; validate_artifact accepted.
findings.repair: Validator reconstructs first compatible source per value/seed/initializer cell, requires expected reference, rejects negative/boolean indices.
findings.verification: Same corruption now raises Invalid solver sweep: Initial reference must identify the first compatible saved physical starts in this cell.

findings.problem: Reopening/importing custom contamination seed silently replaced it with measurement seed+606 on rerun.
findings.repair: Explicit contamination seed control is restored and used by payload.

findings.problem: UI zeroed per-beacon offsets outside affected_beacons even though the backend affected list governs NLOS only.
findings.repair: UI uses explicit full offsets vector independently of NLOS affected list.

findings.problem: Noisy joint benchmark tables preferred raw errors while aggregate chart used aligned errors, without frame label.
findings.repair: Root reports benchmark table changed to backend start_table including explicit error_frame.
findings.verification: Current renderBenchmark uses backend start_table with error_frame for all validated source artifacts; aggregate plot uses those same backend aggregate metrics.

findings.problem: UI Run CSV and benchmark CSV flatten only available decision/dropped records, omitting failed starts with no decisions and no dropped observations. Attempt status and message also absent. Backend sweep CSV preserves all starts.
findings.required_repair: Export one row per attempted start (backend start_table for benchmark) and/or include status/error source-observation placeholder rows for unavailable decisions. Preserve dropped ping timing from source_experiment observation.
findings.repair: allObservationRows now includes every undecided source record with null decision/weight and explicit unavailable message; source timestamps restored. RunCSV includes attempt status/message. Benchmark has separate AttemptsCSV from backend start_table plus separately labeled ObservationsCSV.

positive_checks: Independent fit remains isolated from labels; no integration path feeds contamination_reference to optimizer.
Within each sweep cell variants share the same saved experiment; configurations and derived all-attempt tables recomputed offline.
Unknown metrics are null in core/aggregate and undefined in decision summary, with failed attempts retained in aggregate denominators.
Scene schema6 uses shared stable uirevision/camera and M3 ping playback hook; M6 adds no camera reset or comparison-alignment rewrite.
Scene rays derive estimator decisions; injected labels remain in separate per-range table/hover data.
Transient/permanent terminal persistence tests retain numerical outcomes in live jobs and distinguish infrastructure status; recovery does not promise unreadable-main-file durability.
limitations: Static source and Node harness review; visual acceptance remains separate root/UI-agent evidence.
Readability of every historical M6 acceptance artifact should be checked against final current validators.
